title: fix(console): a metadata create form says so next to Name when the label cannot fill it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPVve4Xc2Nd78tQUar4agBb)_

Fixes #28232
Refs #28180

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新建元数据（权限集、视图、流程、页面、动作、钩子、仪表板、文档）时，如果显示名称里没有拉丁字母或数字（例如全中文、全日文），API 名称框下会多一行提示「无法从此显示名称生成名称，请手动输入（snake_case）」；英文界面是 "This label can't be turned into a name; type one in snake_case."。用户填了名称，这行提示就消失。
- 为什么改：Console 只用显示名称里的拉丁字母和数字自动生成名称；中文或日文名称生成的是空值，名称框空着且必填，旁边却没有任何话说明原因（#28232，从 #28180 拆出的可选半边）。
- 风险与回滚：只加一行提示文字；名称怎么生成、保存怎么校验、服务端都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/createDerive.ts`（`underivableTargets`：什么时候算「生成不了」）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`（新可选属性 `fieldNotes`，画在字段说明下面）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`（把提示交给两处 `SchemaForm`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.underivableName-28232.test.tsx`，预期 2 个用例全绿；或在中文界面的 Console 新建权限集，显示名称填「销售运营」，名称下出现这行橙色提示，填入名称后消失。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**When the line shows** (`underivableTargets` in `createDerive.ts`): for each `createDerive` rule whose transform is `slugify`, the target is listed when the source holds non-blank text, `slugify` of that text is empty, and the target is empty. A typed Name drops it at once; clearing Name again brings it back while the label still gives nothing. `slugify` itself is unchanged (no transliteration). `useCreateDerive` returns the list as `underivable` (empty when derivation is suspended, i.e. outside create mode).

**Where it shows.** `SchemaForm` gains an optional `fieldNotes` prop: one host-supplied line per top-level field, drawn under the field's help text in both the flat and the sectioned layouts (and on boolean rows), never deferred like an issue. `ResourceEditPage` maps `underivable` to the translated line and passes it to both of its `SchemaForm` call sites: the create form, and the designer's inspector fallback (the `doc` type's create page). The hunks sit in the `useCreateDerive` block and on the two `SchemaForm` prop lists, away from what #28296 moved; `main` with #28296 is merged in.

**Copy.** New key `engine.create.nameNotDerived` in the `studio` namespace: en "This label can't be turned into a name; type one in snake_case.", zh "无法从此显示名称生成名称，请手动输入（snake_case）。" (the form's zh label for `label` is 显示名称). The namespace ships `en` and `zh` only; the other eight locales fall back to English there, as for every Studio string.

**Rider from the #28229 review** (help length at `colSpan: 1`): measured on the live Console (backend `--fresh` + the Console dev server from this branch, Chromium, permission-set create form) in en and zh-CN at 1280 px and 820 px wide. The help wraps onto a second or third line (`white-space: normal`, `overflow: visible`, `scrollWidth == clientWidth` on the help element) and is never truncated, so nothing changes there. Screenshots: `en0.png`, `en1.png`, `zh1.png`, `en-820.png`, `zh-820.png` in the project folder `ui-seat-1/r2026-10-30/out/28232/`.

## Tests

New: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.underivableName-28232.test.tsx` (2), the real page with the live registrations (`registerBuiltinAnchors`) and the real served permission form from `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`:

- (a) an all-Chinese label: exactly one line, in the Name row (not the Label row), Name empty; typing a Name removes it; clearing Name brings it back;
- (b) CONTROL: a label with Latin letters fills Name (`Sales 运营` → `sales`) with no line; a pristine form and a cleared label show none.

**Ablation** (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each mutation proved on disk and restored to the HEAD blob):

- the page hands `SchemaForm` no notes (`underivable.length > 0` → `< 0`) → (a) red, (b) green;
- `underivableTargets` ignores a typed Name (the target-holds-a-value line deleted) → (a) red at "goes away once a Name is typed", (b) green.

## Acceptance notes

- The object and report designers keep their own Name input in their curated home panels (`ObjectDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`), so their create pages do not show this line; that is outside the order's file surface (the create form and `createDerive`).
- Seen while measuring, not changed: on the same form with an all-Chinese label, the page's summary banner already lists Name's two schema errors in English ("Identifier must be at least 2 characters", "Identifier must be lowercase snake_case, …") in the zh-CN UI too, and the second one is cut with an ellipsis at 820 px. That banner text and its width are not this card's.
- `Clause-②: no` follows the precedent of #28293 (#28179), which added the optional `SchemaForm` prop `onRequiredRowFieldsChange` under `Clause-②: no`; `fieldNotes` is the same shape of change. The seat may judge otherwise.
